text: Provide proof that the 15 USC 1691 c ; 15 USC 1642 ; USC 1681M and USC 1692K doesn't apply to them. They denied me of my credit and violated my rights. I stated my credit worthiness and the chose to discriminate me. I have sent 3 notice of their law breaking via certified mail. I explained their actions qualify as an adverse action on a consumer and it is unlawful for any creditor to discriminate against an applicant with any aspect to their credit, withholding access to my securities is securities fraud.
